Name: boleto Fish Gutting Machine
Description:
A Journey of Innovation That Began in 1972...
Over 50 years ago, in a small factory in Denmark, Leif Thomsen identified a global issue in the fish processing industry: the lack of an efficient fish gutting solution. From this need, Boleto Maskinfabrik was born with a mission to revolutionize the sector.

The journey wasn’t easy. We faced significant challenges: creating a machine that meets high-quality standards, improves efficiency, reduces waste, and adapts to different species. Through innovation and refinement, we achieved what many thought was impossible.

The Challenge: Revolutionizing an Industry
As we gained experience, we better understood our customers’ needs: slow processes, high waste, downtime, and the need for customized solutions. We set out not just to sell machines but to offer complete solutions.

This led to the creation of the Boleto gutting machine, capable of processing up to 50 fish per minute with less than 0.5% damage. Each machine is tailored to meet the unique specifications of our clients. This wasn’t just technology—it was the solution the fish processing industry needed.

What we do: 
We provide producers in the sugar industry with instruments that can measure sugar solution colour of crystalline sugars in real-time - without dissolving the crystals.


Why we do it:
First and foremost, it’s very important for producers to be able to comply to the needs of their customers when it comes to quality of sugar. 
Secondly, many producers operate with an extremely wide safety margin which leads them to produce a far better quality to their customers than they need to. 
Thirdly, many producers within the sugar industry benefits from colour measurement as an internal tool for process control and production optimization.
These needs call for a method of measurement that is both extremely accurate and simultaneously can deliver results in real-time.


How we do it:
Through the use of advanced technology, we have developed a range of instruments specifically designed for the demands in the sugar industry. 
Recently we have developed additional lines of instruments, which can be applied in many new applications like inside batch centrifugals, inside continuous centrifugals, in blending yellow or brown sugars, in switching between green and white run-offs, and in sending high colour product to remelt instead of to the dryer.

Vi fremstår i dag som en tidssvarende og moderne maskinfabrik med dygtige medarbejdere, som kontinuerligt og konstant tilpasser os markedet hvori vi opererer. Det skal være trygt at være kunde hos 2M-Industri.

Name: Deepvis
Description:
Med 15 års samlet erfaring i plastindustrien giver vi agile plastproducenter det første AI visionsystem, der selv tilpasser sig:
• Nye designs
• Nye produktvarianter
• Nye fejltyper

Vores system lærer direkte fra dine egne operatører og deres vurdering af defekter – og vigtigst af alt, den bliver klogere for hvert eneste emne den ser.

Brugervenlighed
Deepack er designet af operatører til operatører. Vi gør op med forvirrende programmer, der har for mange funktioner og indstillinger du ikke har brug for. Vores AI indstiller sig selv, så du ikke behøvet at uddanne dine medarbejdere i at bruge den. Vores platform gør det let at træne systemet ved blot at godkende eller afvise defekter, præcis som den bedste operatør ville gøre. Vores system spørger selv om validering hvis den er i tvivl.

Datadrevet optimering
Modsat traditionelle visionsystemer som ikke bliver klogere, bruger vi løbende billeder direkte fra kameraet til at lære modellen at blive dygtigere og mere præcis. Det giver et mere robust system med konstant up-time, fordi den reagerer på hvad den ser hver dag. Det giver os også mulighed for systemet til helt selv at justere ind til nye fejltyper eller produktdesigns. 

Eliminering af dyre serviceaftaler
Vi giver dig magten tilbage til at styre dit eget visionsystem, Med vores system er du ikke afhængig af eksterne visionteknikkere, eller internt optrænede medarbejdere.

Name: ACT Logimark Danmark A/S
Description:
ACT Logimark forretningsområde

Totalleverandør af maskiner, udstyr og løsninger til mærkning og sporbarhed af produkter og emballage til alle brancher. ACT Gruppen startede op i 1990 i Norge og leverer i dag maskiner, udstyr og løsninger til virksomheder i Danmark, Sverige og Norge.

ACT-selskaberne har siden sin etablering i 1990 bygget et et solidt leveringsprogram op, og samarbejder i dag med kendte producenter i mange lande. ACT’s leveringsprogram omfatter både hardware og software, og vi kan både tilbyde skræddersyede løsninger som er tilpasset vores kunders respektive behov.
Erfaring, konkurrencedygtige priser, høj driftssikkerhed og lave driftsomkostninger er nogen af vores vigtigste parametre.

ACT Servicecenter består af teknikere og ingeniører inden flere fagområder - inklusivt software, som arbejder med følgende:
•	Konsulentarbejde og salg 
•	Projektarbejde
•	Installationer og igangsætninger   
•	After sale support 
•	Serviceaftaler
•	Prøveinstallationer
•	Komplette systemløsninger 

Uddrag af ACT Logimarks leveringsprogram:
•	Lasermærkning
•	Blækstråleprintere
•	LogiFlow Software - modulbaseret softwareløsning.
•	Etiketprintere (både en farve og fuldfarve)
•	Etiketteringsmaskiner
•	Farvebånd og specialetiketter
•	Vægte til alle opgaver

Name: Krogh Ventilation ApS
Description:
Vi er et nystartet firma i Nordsjælland, med stor erfaring indenfor ventilation montage. Vi påtager os gerne store som små opgaver inden for al ventilationsteknik. Vi udfører også rådgivning og konsulentbistand, så I får den rigtige og optimale løsning.
Vi kommer gerne forbi og giver et uforpligtende tilbud på jeres projekt. Vi har samarbejde med både en tegnestue og beregner af luftmængder, samt dimensionering af anlæg, så både tegninger og dokumentation er i orden inden anlægget sættes i drift.

Skulle dette have vakt jeres interesse, er i velkommen til at kontakte os.

Name: GreenMatic A/S
Description:
Hos GreenMatic reparerer og ombytter vi defekte moduler til alle områder inden for automation. Som den eneste leverandør i Danmark leverer vi reservedele til Texas Instrument CTI og Siemens Simatic S5/S7. 

Vi tilbyder hard- og software til industriel IT og automation, der optimalt løser behovet i styrings- og informationshåndtering. Vi servicerer moduler til både nye og ældre anlæg. Vi opgraderer også anlæg med trådløs kommunikation.

Vi dækker områder som CNC-styring, frekvensomformer, PLC, reguleringsudstyr, motorer, HMI, netværkskomponenter og back up batterier. 

GreenMatic leverer desuden kliniske, vandtætte tastaturer til blandt andet sundhedssektoren og fødevare- og medicinalindustrien, der udviklet med øje for brugernes daglige behov. 
 
Vi står til rådighed alle årets 365 dage. Kontakt os for yderligere specifikationer eller besøg vores e-shop: greenmatic-eshop.dk

Name: RN Robotics
Description: AAU spin-off company that develops advanced robotics, utilizing AI and advanced navigation, which can be used in e.g. agriculture, industry or defence.

Name: SBK Belt
Description:
Skandinavisk Båndkompagni A/S offers all types of conveyor belts for bulk or general cargo conveying and accessories, including fitting and service.
SBK A/S has more than 25 years of experience in conveyor belts. We supply high quality products and a 24-hour service. We operate with short delivery times and competitive prices and provide our customers with competent consultancy and advice.
Our trademarks are expertise, practical experience and high-quality products and processes. We are proud to deliver good, reliable craftsmanship. No matter the task, we strive to enter a dialogue with the customer to ensure that the solution reached is adapted to match our partners' wishes and needs.

Name: Compower ApS
Description:
Stærke agenturer som sikrer kvaliteten er grundkonceptet hos Compower
Faglig kompetence, fleksibilitet og en tæt dialog med danske virksomheder er baggrunden for, at Compower i dag hører til en af de førende udbydere af AC motorer, DC motorer, stepmotorer, elektromagneter samt blæsere og ventilatorer i alle tænkelige størrelser. Det er en position, der langt fra skyldes tilfældigheder.

Mens mange taler om, at man skal koncentrere sig om dét, man er god til, har Compower praktiseret det i årevis. Det er det bedste fundament for en holdbar succes. Læg dertil evnen til at udvikle og vedligeholde tætte relationer med dygtige producenter, så leveringstid og pris altid stemmer. Det tegner et samlet billede af en virksomhed med en professionel holdning til både kunder og kolleger.

Kabalen går op, fordi vi brænder for vores forretningsområde. Vi er engagerede i den enkelte ordre og sætter en ære i at følge den helt til dørs med præcis levering til aftalt tid og pris. Det er engagementet, der gør forskellen.

På vores lager og værksted kan vi samle serier af motorer og gear, så kunden kan få leveret det rette styk-tal efter de præcise specifikationer. Vi kan ligeledes tilbyde bufferlager for vores kunder, så de kan få leveret komponenter direkte til deres produktion efter just-in-time princippet.

Name: JM maskinteknik
Description:
JM-maskinteknik er en enkeltmandsvirksomhed, der primært fungerer som underleverandør. Virksomhedens absolutte fokus er at levere emner med høj kvalitet til tiden. 
Den vigtigste opgaver hos JM-maskinteknik er at producere maskinbearbejdede emner til kunder i danske og internationale virksomheder. Konstruktion af emner i samarbejde med kunden er ligeledes væsentlig. 
JM-maskinteknik leverer konkurrencedygtige CNC-bearbejdede emner, som lever op til de krav om kvalitet og præcision, som en given kunde ønsker.

Name: LOGITEK
Description:
Virksomheden blev grundlagt af Kristian M. Laursen i år 2000 med det formål at drive rådgivende Ingeniørvirksomhed. Hurtigt blev virksomheden inddraget i mere omfattende opgaver, særlig omkring reparation og renovering af pumper til især fødevareindustrien. 
I forbindelse med det stigende antal opgaver, så udviklede virksomheden sig naturligt, med kompetencer indenfor større maskinreparationer, renovering af procesudstyr og industriservice i bla fødevare-maskinindustrien og på maritime anlæg.
I årene frem til 2010 blev virksomheden inddraget i stadig større projekter, omkring udvikling af specialværktøjer og udstyr, til så forskellige brancher som blandt andet Fødevare-maskinindustrien, Elforsyning og generatoranlæg, Stråtækning, Lufthavnsvæsen, beredskab og vej og områdebelysning.
Vores stærkeste kort er vores netværk til og i andre brancher, dette sætter os i stand til at løse og ikke mindst deltage i endog meget komplekse projektopgaver på tværs af mange fag og myndighedsområder.
I de seneste 15 år er rådgivning og rekruttering til forskellige virksomheders advisory boards og bestyrelser, udviklet til et selvstændigt forretningsområde.
I dag beskæftiger virksomheden sig hovedsagelig med projektledelse og Supply-Chain aktiviteter, indenfor flere brancher.
Dette efter devisen om at være effektiv, ordholdende og altid diskrete.

Name: Søborg Køl A/S
Description:
Søborg Køl tilbyder professionelle installationer og servicering af både små og store køleanlæg - med tillid, ansvar og kvalitet som ledetråd.
”Vi ønsker ikke at være de største, vi vil bare være de bedste”.
Viden og ekspertise
Søborg Køl tilbyder høj viden og ekspertise indenfor køleanlæg og kølesystemer målrettet små og store virksomheder i hele Danmark. 

Vi er kendte for ikke at gå på kompromis med vores køleteknik og vores design.

Vores produktionsspecialister, som løbende bliver uddannet indenfor de sidste nye teknologier, sørger for at installationen overholder de krav I selv definerer, eller hjælper med at dimentionere den rigtige løsning til opgaven. 

Kvalitet
Kvalitet kommer før alt andet – vi tilbyder intelligente totalløsninger indenfor køling herunder køleanlæg, hvor beregninger af omkostninger af energiforbrug er en vigtig faktor.

Vi er kendt for vores høje viden indenfor køleanlæg og specielt tilpassede løsninger til private virksomheder og offentlige institutioner – alle kunder tilbydes rådgivning, både til eksisterende eller fremtidige projekter.

Vi ved, hvilke regler der gælder for køleanlæg – både hvad angår miljøgodkendelser og regler som loven foreskriver.

Når I handler med os
Når I handler med Søborg Køl, er I sikre på en høj og effektiv service af driftssikre køleanlæg – vores kvalitets afdeling sørger for, at alt hvad vores design afdeling tegner eller vores montage center fortager sig, bliver kvalitetssikret i henhold til de procedurer vi har forpligtet os til i vores ISO certificering.

Name: APEX Dynamics Denmark
Description:
APEX Dynamics startede i 1987 med produktionen af robotter til plastikstøbemaskiner.

Efter at have etableret sig på markedet, begyndte APEX Dynamics at producere høj præcisions planetgear til servomotorer for at imødekomme efterspørgslen fra markedet.

APEX Dynamics er drevet af en innovationsånd, der gør, at de har konstant fokus på at forbedre produktkvaliteten, leverer det bedste produkt og at de yder den bedste services om matcher de krav industrien stiller.

For at kunne udvikle produkter og udvide deres globale salgsnetværk, har APEX Dynamics investeret kraftigt i arbejdskraft og ressourcer.

* Kort leveringstid – standard gear leveres inden for 14. dage
Hurtig leveringstid af gear er et vigtigt parameter for dig, derfor optimerer APEX Dynamics konstant deres produktionskapacitet og producerer mere end 90% af deres gear i egne faciliteter. Effektiv produktion og lagerkontrol gør, at APEX kan levere dit gear inden for kort tid hvad enten det drejer sig om et special gear eller ved større mængder.

* Konfigurering af gear skal være nemt og hurtig
Din tid er kostbar, derfor har APEX Dynamics udviklet et designværktøj, hvor du kan konfigurere dit gear inden for få minutter.

Når du har konfigureret dit gear, har du adgang til tegninger i flere filformater. Adgangen til tegninger kan forkorte din udviklingsproces markant.

Name: Scangrading
Description:
Sometimes the best way to grow is to reduce.
 
The sugar industry is facing new great opportunities thanks to digitalization improving upon the traditional industrial methods helping sugar factories increase their output and productivity. At Scangrading we contribute to a digitalized sugar industry by providing future-proof artificial intelligence and machine vision systems that are specially designed to automate the measurement and analysis of sugar crystal size distributions and reduce the need for manual labor.
 
Let’s talk about how we can support your automation journey.

Name: Djursland Vand Tech
Description:
Hos Djursland Vand Tech ApS beskæftiger vi os med alt indenfor industriel højtrykrensning samt vandskæring. 
Vi har stor passion for vores egenskab og er eksperter på området. Vi er ikke Danmarks største firma, men måske Danmarks bedste. Vi er beliggende i Trustrup på Djursland, men udfører arbejde i hele Danmark og Norden.

Name: ORTHANIAS
Description:
Orthanias udfører opgaver inden for fagområderne GIS, droneoverflyvning, machine learning og dataanalyse og det med 10 års solid erfaring i det kommunale og private regi. 
Med kompetencerne ét og samme sted leverer Orthanias komplette produkter og kan dermed bevare den røde tråd i opgavens formål.

Name: FEC Consulting
Description:
FEC Consulting er en af Danmarks førende forhandlere af transmissions produkter med primært fokus på transportbånd, transportører, tandremme, tandremskiver, kileremme, poly-v remme, modulbånd, rundremme, vi tilbyder altså stort set alt hvad hjertet kan begære af tilbehør og special udviklede transportløsninger.

Hos FEC Consulting er vi din tætte sparringspartner, der altid står klar med individuel rådgivning og
sparring vedrørende jeres virksomheds fremtid. Som kunde hos os, er du altid sikret skræddersyet og personlig
service, hvor vi gennem en tæt dialog med dig, sætter os grundigt ind i dine behov og ønsker. 
Vi rådgiver altid ud fra den bedste løsning – både nu og i fremtiden. De varer du modtager, er alt andet end samlebåndsarbejde, men tager udgangspunkt i din forretning, produktion og organisation

Efter 2. generationer og mere end 20 års erfaring, har vi opbygget et indgående kendskab til mange
brancher og industrier, samt en stor faglig og teknisk viden. Det er vigtigt for os, at kunne opretholde en bred produktviden, og vi deltager derfor løbende i kurser samt på ind- og udenlandske messer, så vi er rustet til at
kunne yde den bedste og mest kvalificerede service. Hos FEC Consulting ønsker vi at skabe værdi for vores kunder, så vores viden og erfaring kommer til vores kunders fordel.

Vi er en agil samarbejdspartner, der tilpasser sig dine behov og ønsker, da vi ved, at din produktivitet, afhænger af hastigheden og kvaliteten af vores arbejde. Vi forstår vigtigheden af, at vores kunder hurtigt og nemt kan modtage deres varer når behovet opstår - og vi tilbyder derfor ”dagtil- dag levering”, så du altid kan modtage dine varer til tiden. Vi tilbyder derudover logistik, lagerføring samt faste leveringsdage af vores produkter, så dine vareleverancer kan tilpasses jeres virksomhed og produktion.

Name: ContiFlow
Description:
Op til 25% mere kapacitet på lageret
ContiFlows transportsystem sætter ny standard inden for lager og intern transport af pladestakke og EURO paller.

Igennem et patenteret, revolutionerende system, som hele tiden sikrer automatiseret og fuld akkumulering af lageremner ved transportbåndets aflæsningsforkant, medvirker ContiFlow til optimal udnyttelse af lagerkapaciteten samt mere effektivt og sikkert transportflow.

Med ContiFlow kan lagerkapaciteten umiddelbart øges med 25 pct., fordi der nu ikke længere er behov for gulvplads mellem rullebanerne. Hele processen er automatiseret. Elmotorer sikrer hele tiden automatisk fremføring og akkumulering.

Udover bedre pladsudnyttelse er gevinsten bedre arbejdsmiljø.

Name: Universal Bar Feeder ApS
Description:
Universal Bar Feeder ApS is a Danish manufacturer and supplier of fully automated Bar Feeders for loading of  CNC Turning machines. 

The technology on which Universal Bar Feeder is built has been developed in close cooperation with Ejnar Hansens Maskinfabrik, in the small town Broager in the south of Denmark.

At Ejnar Hansen, they are front runners in relation to automation.
"With still increasing demands for product quality and even tighter tolerances, we had reached a point where further efficiency and automation could no longer be achieved with the bar feeders currently available on the market", says Jesper Petersen, CEO of Ejnar Hansen Maskinfabrik

The company was founded in 2017 by Palle Hannemann, Per Lachenmeier and Per Holm Knudsen.

Name: Bernic
Description:
Welcome to Bernic, where quality and customer satisfaction are our top priorities.

Bernic is a Danish company with more than 40 years in the industry. Our enclosures are designed and produced in our facilities in Denmark, and therefore we can supply EUR1 certificate covering all goods and have full control over the supply chain.

We specialize in DIN rail enclosures and offer a diverse range of enclosures specifically designed to meet the unique requirements of various electronic applications. Our comprehensive selection caters to a wide array of industries, including industrial automation, building control systems, and the rapidly growing electric automotive and charging industry.

We provide a wide selection of materials, sizes, colors, and configurations to ensure that you find the perfect enclosure that suits your specific requirements. Additionally, we offer customization services such as laser engraving, milling, and printing, allowing you to personalize your enclosures.

We look forward to collaborating with you.

Name: Flex Hex , the flexible hexapod for reconfigurable workcell
Description:
FlexHex creates flexible and reconfigurable alternative to dedicated jigs and fixtures in production. Utilized for assembly, welding and manufacturing, the FlexHex enables a more cost-effective production line setup, reduced fixture storage and a quicker adaption to other production series.
The Flex Hex solution consists of several Hexapods, the number will depend of the fixture configuration. The Hexapod is fully integratable with other robot activities in production lines. The merging of these two technologoes lead to an economical feasible, flexible and high quality fixture that ensures higher stiffness and accuracy in fixating workpieces in e.g. a production line.

Name: SICK Sensor Intelligence
Description:
SICK is a leading global technology company for intelligent sensor solutions and integrated solutions in industrial automation. Innovative technologies set benchmarks and make industrial processes more efficient, safer, and more sustainable – in both logistics and manufacturing operations. Founded in 1946 by Dr. Erwin Sick and headquartered in Waldkirch near Freiburg, the company has a global presence with a network in around 40 countries. SICK has more than 10,000 employees worldwide and generated a group revenue of EUR 1.8 billion in the 2025 fiscal year. Further information: www.sick.com 

Imprint: https://www.sick.com/imprint/

Name: Universal Robots
Description:
Universal Robots is the global leader in collaborative robotics, enabling companies to automate faster, safety and with greater flexibility. 

With 100,000+ cobots deployed worldwide, Universal Robots has set the standard for user-friendly automation with our intuitive PolyScope software, award-winning training program, and the world's largest cobot ecosystem. Through a wide range of partner solutions, customers can tailor applications, such as machine tending, palletizing, quality inspection, packaging and assembly, to their needs as operations evolve.

From standalone workstations to connected production environments, Universal Robots helps companies automate with confidence across industries including automotive, metal fabrication, electronics and more. 

Universal Robots is part of Teradyne Robotics, a division of Teradyne, Inc. (NASDAQ: TER).

Name: KEYENCE CORPORATION
Description:
KEYENCE is a worldwide leader in the development and manufacturing of factory automation equipment ranging from automation sensors, measuring instruments, vision systems, laser markers and digital microscopes. Our innovative products meet customer requirements in every manufacturing and research industry. 

In our fiscal year 2025, KEYENCE sales reached 7.3 billion US dollars while efficiently operating with around 12,000 employees in 46 countries across the world.  KEYENCE sales have grown at an average annual rate of over 10% for the past 25 years, has been ranked within the top 100 of Forbes’s list of “The World’s Most Innovative Companies” for 8 years in a row, and has been named one of Boston Consulting Group’s “Top 50 Value Creators” for 9 years in a row.

At KEYENCE, we pride ourselves on providing a wide variety of manufacturers the world's best automation technologies. KEYENCE notably offers a full range of services provided by technically trained sales engineers such as application problem solving, technical sales support, and a quick response time to any customer request.

Name: ifm
Description: First a passion, then an idea transformed into success – when it comes to pioneering automation and digitalisation technology, the ifm group is the ideal partner. Since its foundation in 1969, ifm has developed, produced and sold sensors, controllers, software and systems for industrial automation and for SAP-based solutions for supply chain management and shop floor integration worldwide. As one of the pioneers of Industry 4.0, ifm develops and implements consistent solutions to digitalise the entire value chain “from sensor to ERP”. Today, the second-generation family-run ifm group has more than 9,000 employees and is one of the worldwide market leaders. The group combines the internationality and innovative strength of a growing group of companies with the flexibility and close customer contact of a medium-sized company.

Name: FANUC Europe
Description:
FANUC Europe Corporation, headquartered in Echternach, Luxembourg, is the European branch of FANUC Corporation, a global leader in industrial automation. With over 1,500 employees across more than 25 countries, FANUC Europe offers CNC systems, industrial robots, and factory automation solutions tailored to industries such as automotive, aerospace, electronics, and healthcare.

Its key subsidiaries include FANUC Germany, FANUC France, FANUC UK, FANUC Italy, FANUC Iberia, FANUC Poland, FANUC Czech, FANUC Switzerland, FANUC Austria, FANUC Nordic, FANUC Romania, FANUC Adria, FANUC Bulgaria, FANUC Slovakia and FANUC Hungary, ensuring local service, support, and training.

Globally, FANUC is headquartered in Oshino, Japan, operates in over 100 countries, employs 8,000+ people, and has installed more than 9 million CNCs and 1 million robots. Known for reliability, innovation, and precision, FANUC supports digital transformation and Industry 4.0 across manufacturing worldwide.

Name: TOMRA
Description: TOMRA was founded on an innovation in 1972 that began with the design, manufacturing and sale of reverse vending machines (RVMs) for automated collection of used beverage containers. Today TOMRA provides technology-led solutions that enable the circular economy with advanced collection and sorting systems that optimize resource recovery and minimize waste in the food, recycling and mining industries.

Name: BEUMER Group
Description:
The BEUMER Group is an international leader in the manufacture of intralogistics systems for conveying, loading, palletising, packaging, sortation, and distribution. With more than 6000 employees worldwide, the BEUMER Group generates an annual order intake of around EUR 1,39 billion.

The BEUMER Group and its group companies and sales agencies provide their customers with high-quality system solutions and an extensive customer support network around the globe and across a wide range of industries, including bulk materials and piece goods, food/non-food, construction, mail order, post, and airport baggage handling.

Long-term success instead of short-term profits
To achieve long-term success, a company needs sustainable development and reliable partnerships. This requires trust and solid core values.

Responsibility for products ...
These values guide us in our efforts to continually and sustainably improve our products, processes, and organisation. Our pursuit of quality leadership leads to outstanding performance in our work, processes, products, services, and in the quality of our customers' results.

... and the environment
For us, sustainability means a balance between environmental sensitivity, economic success, and social responsibility. Energyefficient, environmentally friendly, and safe production and product design are just as important as avoiding accidents and health risks.

We achieve this through:
•	Energy-efficient product design
•	Future-oriented technologies
•	Prevention of environmental pollution, accidents, and health risks
•	Ongoing product optimisation and employee training
•	Commitment that goes above and beyond legal requirements

Legal notice: https://www.beumergroup.com/en/legal-notice
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/BeumerGroup
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/BeumerGroup
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/beumergroup.careers

Name: Kardex
Description:
Kardex is a leading global partner for intralogistics solutions in an attractive and growing market. 

The Group offers premium automated products, standardized systems, and life cycle services that guarantee high availability and low total cost of ownership. Kardex provides an intelligent entry into automation with its dynamic storage and retrieval systems, offers integrated material handling systems, small parts storage systems, and automated high-bay warehouses, and acts as a global AutoStoreTM partner, offering flexible and modular storage and order fulfillment solutions. 

The Group employs around 2,900 people in over 30 countries. Kardex Holding AG has been listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange since 1989.

Name: IMI Industrial Automation
Description:
We create solutions for our customers that enable smarter, safer, more productive, and sustainable factories, production lines, and warehouse operations. With four trusted product brands—IMI Norgren, IMI Bimba, IMI Bahr, and IMI Buschjost—we deliver a world-class portfolio of motion and fluid control solutions. Each brand brings unique expertise and technologies, ensuring you have access to the right solution for your needs.

For over a century, we have partnered with customers in Industrial Automation, applying our experience and innovation to create lasting value for their businesses. Our solutions support critical industries such as automotive, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and even the space industry, enabling the automation of precision manufacturing, product assembly, testing, and packaging.

Our pneumatic, electric motion, and fluid control systems help machine builders and end users around the world automate and optimise manufacturing and warehousing processes.

 - IMI Norgren specialises in precision pneumatic motion control, offering actuators, air preparation equipment, and valve islands to enhance safety, productivity, and uptime.
 - IMI Bimba delivers pneumatic, hydraulic, electric, and vacuum solutions, providing reliable, customisable platforms for diverse applications.
 - IMI Bahr designs modular positioning systems, including electric cylinders and linear axes, for high-precision and reliable performance.
 - IMI Buschjost provides solenoid and process valves for managing water, air, steam, and aggressive media with safety and reliability.

Name: Mobile Industrial Robots
Description:
At MiR, our Core Values form the foundation of our company and help guide us in our decision making. Our Core Values are essential for our success and serve as the lens through which we evaluate every business decision. Our commitment to these values, in both words and actions, builds a stronger MiR.
 
MiR leverages the strength of Teradyne, a multi-billion-dollar test technology company and trusted supplier to global corporations. As part of Teradyne Robotics, alongside Universal Robots, we are pioneers in advanced robotics, setting innovation standards through the use of AI and other cutting-edge technologies.

Name: OnRobot
Description:
OnRobot is a global company headquartered in the robotics cluster of Odense, Denmark. We provide small and mid-sized manufacturers with a full line of innovative Plug & Produce solutions for collaborative robot applications. Name: CeramicSpeed Bearings A/S
Description:
CeramicSpeed Bearings A/S develop and produce ball bearings, which create significant economic advantages when used in industrial applications. For the past 10 years, we have worked on developing and improving bearing performance, using high-tech components – and today we are the world leaders in our field.

All bearings are handmade in Denmark using components from the best suppliers in the world. We have many years of experience developing hybrid bearing solutions for industrial applications, using ceramic balls of a unique quality together with other specially developed components. CeramicSpeed bearings have unique properties, which can solve challenges where ordinary steel bearings are not good enough. In addition to this, CeramicSpeed bearings have a lifespan that is 4-8 times longer than steel bearings; this simplifies maintenance and increases up time in industrial production.

Bearings that last the longest – are the cheapest!

The cost of bearings themselves form a very small part of the total cost of the machines they are installed in - both in new machinery and in maintenance. However, the cost of maintaining or replacing bearings can be much higher. This means that bearings that last longer can reduce operating costs significantly.

Description:
KILDE Automation is an innovative company developing and producing custom-built machines, automation equipment, and production lines at a high technical level for domestic and foreign industry.

Description:
The highly flexible PTR Robot provides a safer work environment for healthcare professionals and increase patient experience quality. 

The PTR Robot can be used independently of place, purpose, patient, time and caregiver. 

This is “The five dimensions of patient moving and handling”. These five dimensions are the guiding principles for creating and developing the PTR robot. The robot can be used anywhere, for any purpose and patient, at any given time, by any caregiver. No other tool for either patient transfer, handling, moving or rehabilitation has achieved this. 

PTR Robots is a subsidiary from Blue Ocean Robotics in Odense, Denmark, right in the heart of robotics in Northern Europe. The company origins from a Robi-X development partnership between University Hospital Køge in Region Zealand, Denmark and Blue Ocean Robotics. As a spin out company from Blue Ocean Robotics, PTR Robots not only share office, but also, maintain a close relationship with exchange of technology and a joint R&D project team with Blue Ocean Robotics.

Our primary target is to help apoplexia cerebi patients, geriatric residents, quadriplegics and any other human with reduced mobility, related to trauma- or other health issues, where partial or full support is needed for transfer and rehabilitation.

We also aim to improve the work environment related to care givers and recognized by a high number of heavy lift injuries, with huge personal and negative consequences as well as the financial burden.

Description:

Name: DIRA - Danish Industrial Robot Association
Description:
DIRA stands for 'Danish Industrial Robot Association'. It is an association with an independent board for Danish companies and knowledge institutions that are interested in robotics and automation.

Today, several already have robots in operation, others are joining to learn more about this area, in preparation for future investment in the technology.

DIRA was founded in 1982 and counts approximately 200 member companies. The members consist of manufacturing companies that use or are considering robotic technology, system integrators and suppliers of robotic technology, and knowledge institutions that develop and disseminate knowledge about robotic technology.

DIRA works purposefully to improve the competitiveness of Danish companies on the international markets through the introduction of automation and robot technology.

DIRA is a living network that holds many networking events where members meet, learn new things and exchange experiences. As a member of DIRA, you are not alone with your automation challenges, but are part of a strong professional network, where personal relationships are also paramount.

Description:

 Hos Armatec finder du en partner, der kombinerer kvalitet, viden og bæredygtighed – med fokus på løsninger, der holder.

Description:
Vi er en af Sydvestjyllands største lønlakerer og holder til i Agerbæk mellem Esbjerg og Grindsted.

Jyllak Pulver- og Autolakering blev opført i 1989 og bestod dengang af en pulver- og en autolakeringsbygning samt en kontorbygning. Siden da er virksomheden løbende blevet udvidet med yderligere tre haller og en større kontorbygning, og har i dag et produktions- og grundareal på hhv. 6.000m2 og 15.000m2. Jyllak ejes af Bjarne Kristensen, som siden 1986 har beskæftiget sig med pulver- og autolakering.

I 1999 valgte Jyllak at stoppe autolakeringen til fordel for lakering af industrielle emner og skiftede i denne forbindelse navn til vores nuværende navn Jyllak Pulver- og Industrilakering.

Jyllak har i dag 25 medarbejder fordelt på seks afdelinger (P1, P2, P4, Industri, Montage, Slyngrensning) og kontoret.

P1 består af et manuelt pulverlakeringsanlæg som kan pulverlakere og håndtere både fysisk store, tunge og komplicerede metalemner. 

P2 består af et automatisk pulverlakeringsanlæg, som muliggør hurtige farveskift, hvilket gør at der i denne afdeling kan pulverlakeres såvel små som store serier af metalemner. 

I Industri vådlakeres emner af diverse kunststofs-typer (ABS, PP, PE, PS og nylon) samt jern, stål, træ og glasfiber manuelt. Afdelingen består endvidere af en vådlakeringsrobot, som anvendes til store serier af emner. 

I montageafdelingen monteres, pakkes og emballeres lakerede emner efter kundens ønsker. I forbindelse med montageafdelingen har vi endvidere en lønpaklinie med 10 cirkulærfødere og kopelevatorer.
 
I slyngrensningsafdeling slyngrenses metalemner enten som en selvstændig opgave eller som forbehandling før en lakeringsopgave.

Name: Nordic AM Group
Description:
The Nordic AM Group is a network organization working to enhance and support Additive Manufacturing in the Nordics. Established by national AM centers, hubs and foundations in Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Finland we work across borders to inspire, inform and implement Additive Manufacturing in the Nordic industry through technology, innovation and business value creation. 
 
The Nordic AM Group aims to foster additive manufacturing growth and innovation by shortening the road to success for the industry. This we do to ensure that the region will continue to create value, sustainable production and use innovative technologies to improve our lives and societies. 
 
Our vision is to accelerate the Nordics to a strong AM region by focusing on competence building, education, research and industrial development. The Nordic AM Group provides a shared platform of knowledge, openness and collaboration to attract talent, investment and growth to the region. 

What we offer the industry, SMEs, universities and other interested:
- An open platform for knowledge sharing and an entrance to the different ecosystems in the Nordics. 
- Four events every year, one in each of the four countries.
- Cases for inspiration
- Mentorships and guidance – matching you with the players in the ecosystem with the right knowledge for you. 
 
Through the partners we offer:
- Training and courses from technology to leadership 
- Design for AM, tech support and R&D
- Printing facilities from polymer to metal and lots of printer insights
- Material knowledge
- Help to setup working environments with AM and follow standards
- National reports and insights
